A fire crackled low and warm as we cupped hands around mugs. Lunch was soup and bread eaten in silence. We played cards and watched the storm push the pines. Sleep came behind wool blankets. Dawn found the lake hushed and bright.

On the final day, I crossed the shallow lane with enough pride to smile at the surface.

# Learning to Swim as an Adult

I stood at the pool edge and stared at the water. My legs shook and my mind raced. The instructor spoke calm words and I did as asked. I blew bubbles and kicked my feet. The cold water pulled at my hands. I fell in once and coughed hard. Yet I returned to the wall again. Each small breath gave hope. The pool that once seemed vast began to shrink. I am not fast and I am not bold. I am learning and I am here.

More soon.
